# axiz-core-outbox

The relay uses a monotonic deadline captured before obtaining its claim connection. It starts a
send only if the remaining lease covers the publisher's declared budget. Database adapters use
database time to claim and expire leases; `OutboxRecord.leaseUntil` is informational for the relay.
Application `Clock` still timestamps publication and retry scheduling.

`BoundedPublisher` and `PublishBound` propagate known and unknown route budgets through routing and
observation. A custom publisher without a known bound needs an explicit
`axiz.outbox.relay.publish-budget` when a relay is created. The fallback covers unknown routes and
never reduces a known maximum. Direct core consumers can use the constructor accepting both lease
and publication budget explicitly. Claims and completion updates require an owner and are
fenced by it.

`claim-allowance` (default 2 s) sizes the lease at startup; a slower claim can still publish if its
actual remaining budget is sufficient. Lease validation requires `lease - margin >= budget +
claim-allowance`, with `margin = lease / 100 + 2 ms`. Equality is accepted. Listener callbacks expose
claim duration and exhausted budgets without making core depend on Micrometer.

These are admission guarantees, not hard real-time delivery guarantees. Process pauses or a broker
operation that continues after the caller times out can exceed the lease. Owner fencing and
idempotent consumers remain necessary for physical duplicate deliveries and uncertain outcomes.

Transactional outbox: JDBC store and relay to any EventPublisher, at-least-once.

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-core-outbox</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `OutboxException` | Outbox persistence failure. |
| `OutboxRecord` | A pending (or processed) outbox entry. |
| `OutboxRelay` | Moves outbox entries to the broker (at-least-once). |
| `OutboxStore` | Persistence port of the outbox. |
| `OutboxWriteTracing` | Keeps the trace of the caller with each event written to the outbox. |
| `OutboxWriter` | Registers events in the outbox within the caller's transaction. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl core/axiz-core-outbox verify`.

## JDBC

The JDBC implementation and SQL resources live in `axiz-adapter-outbox-jdbc`; this module contains
framework-neutral contracts and orchestration, and `TransactionRunner` lives in
`pe.axiz.core.commons.tx`. A service adds the JDBC adapter of a capability with `axiz add` (or the
Initializr); see [JDBC boundaries](../../arquitectura/jdbc.md).
